$comment: Minute keys set the minimum ages for idle PRs, unowned red CI, refused updates, held lanes and dead holders; reviewRoundCap sets the base review cap, maxRungAttempts bounds repeated recovery, and rungs enables individual actions. The cascade is the standard default in liveness-sweep-core.mjs → platform preference livenessSweep in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json → this file → env. Rungs default to dry-run: only rungs set true here ever act, and only under --apply; operator notification is always on and no recovery loosens a gate or human review.
